summary: Iteration 40 — Retest of the Tournament Bulk PDF Compiler (bulk-print-btn) after the two flagged fixes from iteration_39.json. Both P0/MEDIUM regressions are resolved. Seeded a fresh league + active 9-hole round + 2 members + 2 cards (Card A director-only, Card B player-only) via API, then drove RoundScorecard.jsx as the director in both the ACTIVE and COMPLETED views, plus a non-director player pass on the completed view. 22/22 assertions PASS. Screenshot /app/.screenshots/completed_bulk_overlay.png shows the overlay opened on the COMPLETED view rendering two green ScorecardGrids stacked (Card A · 1 player + Card B · 1 player) with toolbar (Print again / Close) — exactly the P0 layout invariant. window.print() fires ~350ms after mount (silent try/catch, no console error). No regressions detected: sweep-finalize-btn still renders on the active card-picker row, and the completed early-return branch remains strictly unmounted (no simulators, no card builder, no hole nav, no sweep-finalize-btn, no new-card-btn). Non-director sees zero bulk-print-btn nodes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct route is /rounds/{roundId}. Firebase token: localStorage['firebase:authUser:<apiKey>:[DEFAULT]'].stsTokenManager.accessToken. League create schema: {name, location, format, entry_fee} — NOT the num_weeks/holes_per_round shape. Rounds are created via POST /api/leagues/{id}/rounds with {season_id, name, date, holes, par_per_hole, publish_announcement}. `season_id` is available from GET /api/leagues/{id}/seasons (auto-created on league creation). Card creation accepts player_ids as user uids OR member ids (test uses uids and it works). Profile-photo modal blocks clicks unless dismissed — always call 'Skip for now' after login/signup. Both bulk-print-btn testids are now unique per view: one on the active shared row (line 604) and one on the completed shared row (line 396). No further action needed for this feature.
